name: Aragon
summary: Four red stripes on gold, the Senyera of the Crown of Aragon, with the Aragonese coat of arms toward the hoist.
origin: The red and gold stripes were the royal sign of the Crown of Aragon from the 12th century. The flag with the arms was adopted in 1984.

symbols.name: Coat of arms
symbols.description: Four quarters: the oak of Sobrarbe, the Íñigo Arista cross, the Cross of Saint George with four Moors' heads, and the Senyera.
symbols.meaning: The historical kingdoms and legends of Aragon.

facts: The four red stripes are shared with Catalonia, Valencia and the Balearic Islands.
clues: Four red stripes on gold with a quartered shield.
Its stripes belonged to a medieval crown.
